name: msap-alumni-backend
description: Production-grade, secure Node.js + Express backend with Supabase PostgreSQL for MSAP Alumni

scripts.scan: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),patterns=[/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]{20,}/,/SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]{20,}/,/JWT_SECRET=[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]{32,}/,/SMTP_PASS=[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]{10,}/,/-----BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY-----/];function scan(dir){fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>{const p=path.join(dir,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()&&e.name!=='node_modules'&&e.name!=='.git')scan(p);else if(e.isFile()){const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');patterns.forEach(rx=>{if(rx.test(c))console.log('⚠️  Possible secret in:',p)})}})}scan('.');"

author: MSAP
